summary: Max Verstappen converted pole position into victory at Mexico City, his fourth consecutive win at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez. Ferrari's internal strife intensified when team orders miscommunication between Hamilton and Leclerc allowed both drivers to fight for the lead, ultimately costing them podium positions. Kimi Antonelli clinched the world championship during the race, becoming F1's youngest-ever title winner, while Verstappen extended his lead in the drivers' standings.
